title: MAIN-IMAGE Registry
official: Multifactorial Analysis of Coronary Artery Plaques Using INtracoronary IMAGing for Exploration of Atherosclerotic Determinants and Progression - the MAIN-IMAGE Registry
summary: All comers registry with patients with chronic coronary syndrome or acute coronary syndrome who underwent intracoronary imaging during cardiac catherization. The aim is to identify plaque characteristics on OCT or IVUS that are associated with adverse cardiac events including myocardial infarction and atherosclerotic progression.
